lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Data gathering day! Kailangan natin ng 120 survey respondents para sa {course} thesis natin. Mainit pero kaya 'to!
lines.textEn: Data gathering day! We need 120 survey respondents for our {course} thesis. Sweltering out here, but we can do it!

choices.text: Mag-bahay-bahay at magbigay ng candies sa respondents (-₱90, ++GWA).
choices.textEn: Go door-to-door with small thank-you candies (-₱90, ++GWA).

choices.text: Mag-hybrid QR code at classroom survey para tipid (-₱30, +GWA).
choices.textEn: Run hybrid QR codes and classroom surveys to cut printing costs (-₱30, +GWA).

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Chapter 4 & 5 overnight! May dalawang thermos ng kape at pancit canton — kapag natapos natin 'to tonight, safe na tayo sa mock defense!
lines.textEn: Chapter 4 & 5 overnight sprint! Two thermoses of coffee and pancit canton — finish tonight and we cruise into mock defense!

choices.text: Tapusin ang statistical analysis at charts hanggang 3AM! (-Energy, ++GWA)
choices.textEn: Finish the analysis and charts until 3 AM! (-Energy, ++GWA)
